public_warning: This dashboard is a soil habitat translator. It explains likely habitat conditions from mapped soils and regional microbial context; it does not confirm exact microbes at a site.
dashboard_rules: Start with mapped soil habitat: texture, pH, carbonate, depth, drainage, organic matter, plant indicators.
Show component mixtures so map units are not treated as uniform soil bodies.
Split true wet/flood soils from clay wet-dry microsites.
Gate low-property records to low-confidence public claims.
Keep microbe names, gene IDs, and raw tables in technical/appendix sections.
